translation: Acrid in flavor. It treats brightening of the eyes and supplementing the center (補中). The root and stem [made into] a decoction treats cold damage (傷寒), chills and fever, sweating, wind stroke (中風), facial swelling, wasting-thirst (消渴), heat in the center (熱中), and water [accumulation]. It grows on the level marshland of Lushan.
